groups.canonical_name: EV battery critical mineral supply constraints
groups.definition: Shortages or cost increases of lithium, nickel, cobalt, rare earths and other critical minerals could raise EV production costs and impede the company's EV strategy.

groups.canonical_name: EV strategy execution and battery costs
groups.definition: Failure to reduce battery cell and pack costs and execute the EV strategy could result in losses, including inventory write-downs on EV-related components.
